methodology.latency: response consumption minus request acceptance, in cycles
methodology.percentile: sorted per-request sample at floor(q*(n-1)); no pooling across seeds
methodology.ready: cycle modulo 100 < ready_percent; forced ready during final drain
methodology.traffic: 25% writes; interval 1; load 100%; fixed 10-request directed prelude
methodology.geometry: simulation ROWS=8 COLS=8, four banks, Q_DEPTH=16; default timing tCCD=2
methodology.uncertainty: 10000 paired-seed bootstrap resamples, RNG seed 20260922; descriptive 95% intervals, no multiplicity correction
methodology.limitation: hot_cold and hol seeds change payloads only, not address/operation sequences
